{{nihongo|'''Kamo Shrine'''|鴨神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

'''Kamo Shrine''' (かもじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Kamo, {{ill|Kawanishi, Hyōgo|Q609350|qid=Q609350}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of {{ill|Kawabe District, Hyōgo|Q1042053|qid=Q1042053|lt=Kōbe District}} in {{ill|Settsu Province|Q864163|qid=Q864163}}, and its former rank was gōsha.

=== History ===
It enshrines the ancestral deity of the "Kamo Hōri-be" in {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}} under Settsu sacred lineages. Records were lost in a fire in the {{ill|Tenmei|de|Tenmei (Ära)|fa|تنمی|fr|Ère Tenmei|it|Tenmei|ja|天明|ko|덴메이|pt|Tenmei|ru|Тэммэй|simple|Tenmei|sr|Тенмеи|sv|Tenmei|th|เท็มเม|tr|Tenmei|zh|天明 (日本)|qid=Q1194121}} era (1781-1788), but the shrine still possesses a single white-feather arrow said to have been dedicated by Prince Shino, an imperial descendant of {{ill|Emperor Uda|Q349267|qid=Q349267}}.
* In August of {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 6 (1873), it became a village shrine.
* In February of Meiji 14 (1881), promoted to gōsha.
* In {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 45 (1970), shrine buildings were newly built<ref>Sadatoshi Yoshii, "Shikinaisha Survey Report, Vol. 5" (1977) {{全国書誌番号|78005760}}</ref>.

=== Precinct shrines ===
As of 2019, the deities of precinct shrines are said to be completely unknown (hearing from the chief priest). Deity names from unclear sources are left here for reference.

* Kasuga Shrine {{ill|Ame-no-Tajikarao|Q849412|qid=Q849412|lt=Tajikarao-no-Mikoto}}
* Amaterasu Kōdaijin Shrine Hiwakamiya-no-Mikoto
* Atago Shrine Amekagutsuchi-no-Kami
* Taga Shrine {{ill|Ōkuninushi|Q276944|qid=Q276944|lt=Ōkuninushi-no-Kami}}
* Aragami Shrine Amekagutsuchi-no-Kami
* Kumano Shrine {{ill|Izanagi|Q813858|qid=Q813858|lt=Izanagi-no-Mikoto}}
* Inari Shrine Ōtsuki-hime-no-Mikoto
* Hachiman Shrine {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}}

=== Historic site ===
* {{ill|Kamo site|Q18701075|qid=Q18701075|lt=Kamo Site}} (National {{ill|Historic site|Q1081138|qid=Q1081138}}, designated July 31, 2000)
: Settlement remains from the {{ill|Ancient Egypt|Q11768|qid=Q11768}} and {{ill|Jōmon period|Q52824|qid=Q52824}} through the {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}}. Excavated artifacts are displayed at the Kawanishi City Cultural Properties Museum.

=== Transportation ===
* About 8 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kawanishi-Ikeda Station|Q855900|qid=Q855900}} on {{ill|West Japan Railway Company|Q502125|qid=Q502125}} {{ill|Fukuchiyama Line|Q1154538|qid=Q1154538}}
